  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    theme: flatly

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 8, fig.height = 4.5, dpi = 120)
library(magreport)
run <- params$run
has <- function(x) !is.null(x) && nrow(x) > 0
```

```{css palette}
/* magreport palette: olive greens and desert tones */
body { color: #2B3119; background-color: #FDFBF7; }
h1, h2, h3, h4, .title { color: #353D1F; }
h2 { border-bottom: 2px solid #D8C8A8; padding-bottom: 4px; }
a, a:visited { color: #A8552F; }
a:hover, a:focus { color: #7A3B1E; }
code { color: #7A3B1E; background-color: #F3EBDD; }
.list-group-item.active, .list-group-item.active:hover, .list-group-item.active:focus {
  background-color: #5E6B2F; border-color: #5E6B2F; color: #FFFFFF;
}
.table > thead > tr > th { border-bottom: 2px solid #9C8B6E; }
.table > tbody > tr:nth-child(odd) { background-color: #F7F2E8; }
caption { color: #9C8B6E; }
```

Report generated from `` `r params$results_dir` `` with the
[magreport](https://github.com/AntonioPuriel/magreport) R package.

## Summary

```{r summary}
lines <- character()

if (has(run$mapping)) {
  lines <- c(lines, sprintf("- **Samples:** %d", nrow(run$mapping)))
}
if (has(run$assembly)) {
  kept <- run$assembly[nrow(run$assembly), , drop = FALSE]
  lines <- c(lines, sprintf(
    "- **Assembly:** %s contigs, %.1f Mb, N50 %s bp",
    format(kept$n_contigs, big.mark = ","),
    kept$total_length / 1e6,
    format(kept$n50, big.mark = ",")
  ))
}
if (has(run$bins)) {
  lines <- c(lines, sprintf("- **Bins:** %d from %s",
                            nrow(run$bins),
                            paste(sort(unique(run$bins$binner)), collapse = ", ")))
}
if (has(run$mags)) {
  counts <- count_quality(run$mags)
  lines <- c(lines, sprintf(
    "- **MAGs assessed:** %d (%s)",
    nrow(run$mags),
    paste(sprintf("%d %s", counts$n, counts$quality), collapse = ", ")
  ))
}

knitr::asis_output(paste(lines, collapse = "\n"))
```

## Read mapping

```{r mapping, eval = has(run$mapping)}
plot_mapping_rates(run$mapping)
```

```{r mapping-table, eval = has(run$mapping)}
knitr::kable(run$mapping, caption = "Reads and alignment rate per sample")
```

```{r no-mapping, eval = !has(run$mapping)}
knitr::asis_output("_No mapping summary found._")
```

## Assembly

```{r assembly, eval = has(run$assembly)}
knitr::kable(run$assembly, caption = "Contigs before and after length filtering")
```

```{r no-assembly, eval = !has(run$assembly)}
knitr::asis_output("_No assembly statistics found._")
```

## Bins

```{r bins, eval = has(run$bins)}
knitr::kable(
  as.data.frame(table(binner = run$bins$binner)),
  col.names = c("Binner", "Bins"),
  caption = "Bins per binner"
)
```

## MAG quality

```{r quality-plot, eval = has(run$mags)}
plot_mag_quality(run$mags, facet_by = if (length(unique(run$mags$binner)) > 1) "binner" else NULL)
```

```{r quality-counts, eval = has(run$mags)}
knitr::kable(count_quality(run$mags, by = "binner"),
             caption = "MAGs per quality category (MIMAG thresholds)")
```

```{r quality-table, eval = has(run$mags)}
mags <- run$mags[order(-run$mags$completeness), ]
knitr::kable(
  utils::head(mags, 25),
  row.names = FALSE,
  digits = 2,
  caption = "MAGs, best completeness first (up to 25 shown)"
)
```

```{r no-mags, eval = !has(run$mags)}
knitr::asis_output("_No CheckM2 results found: run the pipeline without --skip_checkm2._")
```

## Taxonomy

```{r taxonomy, eval = has(run$mags) && "phylum" %in% names(run$mags) && !all(is.na(run$mags$phylum))}
plot_taxonomy(run$mags, rank = "phylum", fill_by = "quality")
```

```{r no-taxonomy, eval = !(has(run$mags) && "phylum" %in% names(run$mags) && !all(is.na(run$mags$phylum)))}
knitr::asis_output("_No taxonomy available: run the pipeline with --gtdbtk_db to classify the MAGs._")
```

## Functional annotation

```{r annotation, eval = has(run$annotation)}
knitr::kable(run$annotation, digits = 1,
             caption = "Genes called, annotated and distinct KEGG orthologues per MAG")
```

```{r pathways, eval = has(run$kos), fig.height = 3 + 0.35 * length(unique(run$kos$bin))}
plot_pathway_presence(run$kos, mags = run$mags)
```

```{r no-function, eval = !has(run$kos)}
knitr::asis_output("_No functional annotation found: run the pipeline with --eggnog_db._")
```
